text: The DOCATT entry of an attach carries the document reference, the intake item, the match method, the confidence and the final call ATTACHED, with the classifier version in model_version, the confidence and the type candidates in recommendation, the document, intake item and match method in actions, and the message id of a refusal in outcome; six columns are added to decision_log_entry by the migration of this story.
why: TSD P7 v2 T3.1 defines decision_log_entry without a document reference, an intake item, a match method, a confidence or a message id, and no source fixes the final call value of an attach.
read: TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3.1; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.1 to A2.3; legacy RWB-E1-032 AC1, AC10, AC12 and section 11
impact: Six new nullable columns and one partial unique key in rwb_decision; the two reads expose them in the DecisionLogEntry body

text: DOCATT is a value of the decision code list in force and is read through the rwb-case reference-data contract at the version in force; it is never a constant of the service.
why: The legacy story names the DOCATT entry, and TSD P7 v2 T3.1 types decision_code as a LOV without listing its values.
read: TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3.1 and T3.2; legacy RWB-E1-032 AC1, AC8 and AC12
impact: The reference-data row must exist before the first attach is recorded; the build holds no default code

text: A held item and a refused attach leave no decision record, because no document was stored and no attach decision was taken; the hold stays a match status on the intake item in rwb_document.
why: The legacy story asserts only that no document row is written for a held item and is silent on the decision log.
read: Legacy RWB-E1-032 sections 4, 5, 7, 9; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.2
impact: No entry and no chain position for a held item; the Unmatched list on SCR-31 remains the only record of a hold

text: The DecisionRecorded fact of an attach is keyed by caseId and carries decisionCode, caseId, documentId, intakeItemId, matchMethod, classifierVersion, confidence, approverUserId, finalCall, messageId and inputsRef, with no OCR text, no file and no account number.
why: The fact is declared in the contract of rwb-document without a field-level schema, and the central ledger cannot append an entry without the document reference.
read: RWB-P5-E1032-CON section 12.3 and AC7; Arch v5 slide 42; TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T5.3
impact: The document reference travels on the event; a fact without it is refused rather than read from the document contract

text: The metadata dependency rows stay as the work package fixes them (build none, contract RWB-P5-E1032-CON, integration and external none), and the platform contracts and the rwb-case and rwb-access contracts the DP table adds are built against their fakes from Day 1.
why: The DP table adds ten dependencies that the plan's metadata rows do not carry, and Template and Rules section R5.4 makes C dependencies non-blocking.
read: Template and Rules v1 section R5.5; WP B2-P7-011 story line
impact: No dependency blocks the start of this story; the fakes of section 12.8 are the build surface

text: The story says 'the rwb-decision login (DP-02)' for the database login, keeps the placeholder for the two parameter names and for the texts of MSG-P7-009 and MSG-GEN-006, and reads the parameters through the rwb-case parameters contract.
why: No source readable in this run writes the login name, the parameter names or those two message texts.
read: TSD P7 Decision center and log v2 T3 and T-A; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3; context pack P7
impact: The login is an infrastructure value of the OPS story; the parameter rows are reference data of rwb-case

text: The completeness check of the ledger runs on the ingest window of the parameters contract and needs no Temporal Schedule and no cron entry of this service; JOB-12 stays rwb-document's Schedule and JOB-14 covers the entries.
why: No source states the trigger of the comparison between the documents of a case and the DOCATT entries of the case.
read: Arch v5 slide 28; FSD P7 Decision center and log v3 A2.1.4.4; legacy RWB-E1-032 section 12
impact: No Schedule, no workflow and no task-queue entry from this story; a gap raises the missing-record alert
